# System-Provided Packages — MUST NOT be bundled
# Platform: centos-7.9-x86_64
# Status: PROJECTED from CentOS 7.9 ISO @core group analysis
# Date: 2026-07-22
#
# These packages are part of the minimal CentOS 7.9 installation (@core group)
# OR are considered system-critical. They must NEVER be included in the offline
# bundle. The installer must detect if any of these are missing and abort.

# =============================================================================
# System-Critical (replacing these breaks the OS)
# =============================================================================
glibc-2.17-317.el7.x86_64                            # C library — NEVER replace
glibc-common-2.17-317.el7.x86_64                     # locale, getent, etc.
bash-4.2.46-34.el7.x86_64                            # Shell — NEVER replace
systemd-219-78.el7.x86_64                            # Init — NEVER replace
systemd-libs-219-78.el7.x86_64                       # libsystemd.so.0
rpm-4.11.3-45.el7.x86_64                             # Package manager — NEVER replace
rpm-libs-4.11.3-45.el7.x86_64                        # librpm.so.3
yum-3.4.3-168.el7.centos.noarch                      # Package manager — NEVER replace
kernel-3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64                        # Kernel — NEVER replace

# =============================================================================
# Authentication & Security — ALWAYS present, must not bundle
# =============================================================================
pam-1.1.8-23.el7.x86_64                              # PAM — NEVER replace; all auth depends on it
nss-softokn-freebl-3.44.0-8.el7_7.x86_64             # NSS crypto — NEVER replace
nss-softokn-3.44.0-8.el7_7.x86_64                    # NSS soft token

# =============================================================================
# Core Utilities — @core group, always present on minimal install
# =============================================================================
coreutils-8.22-24.el7.x86_64                         # ls, cp, mv, cat, mkdir, chmod, sha256sum, etc.
util-linux-2.23.2-65.el7.x86_64                      # mount, flock, etc.
shadow-utils-4.6-5.el7.x86_64                        # useradd, groupadd

basesystem-10.0-7.el7.centos.noarch                  # Base system metapackage

# =============================================================================
# SELinux — present when SELinux is enforcing
# =============================================================================
libselinux-2.5-15.el7.x86_64                         # libselinux.so.1

policycoreutils-2.5-34.el7.x86_64                    # restorecon, semanage
selinux-policy-targeted-3.13.1-268.el7.noarch        # Default SELinux policy

# =============================================================================
# C++ Standard Library — system version (TOO OLD for devtoolset-8 build!)
# =============================================================================
libstdc++-4.8.5-44.el7.x86_64                        # SYSTEM: provides libstdc++.so.6 (CXXABI_1.3.7)
libgcc-4.8.5-44.el7.x86_64                           # SYSTEM: provides libgcc_s.so.1

# CRITICAL COMPATIBILITY NOTE:
# TXSQL compiled with devtoolset-8 (GCC 8.3.1) requires CXXABI_1.3.9+.
# CentOS 7.9's libstdc++ (GCC 4.8.5) only provides CXXABI_1.3.7.
# The mysqld binary MUST be statically linked against libstdc++ and libgcc_s:
#   cmake -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-static-libstdc++ -static-libgcc"
# OR the devtoolset-8 libstdc++.so.6 must be placed in private lib/ with RPATH.
# Never replace the system libstdc++ — it would break other processes.

# =============================================================================
# OpenSSL — system version (1.0.2k, EOL)
# =============================================================================
openssl-libs-1.0.2k-19.el7.x86_64                    # SYSTEM: provides libssl.so.10, libcrypto.so.10
openssl-1.0.2k-19.el7.x86_64                         # SYSTEM: /usr/bin/openssl

# CRITICAL COMPATIBILITY NOTE:
# TXSQL may require OpenSSL 1.1.1+ for TLS 1.3. System provides 1.0.2k only.
# Never replace the system OpenSSL — other services depend on it.
# Use MySQL's bundled OpenSSL (cmake -DWITH_SSL=bundled) which places
# libssl.so.1.1 and libcrypto.so.1.1 in the TXSQL install prefix's lib/.
# RPATH ensures TXSQL uses the bundled version, not the system version.
